title: Contact Snapped Up
description: How to contact Snapped Up about a deal, a price that has changed, or an affiliate or brand partnership.
body:
We read every email and usually reply within one working day.

**Email:** [hello@snappedupdeals.co.uk](mailto:hello@snappedupdeals.co.uk)

## Readers

Spotted a price that has changed, a deal that has ended, or a genuine bargain we should cover? Send us the link and we'll check it.

## Brands and affiliate programmes

Snapped Up is an independent UK editorial site. We publish a daily deals roundup, a weekly spotlight and search-led buying guides for Black Friday, Christmas gifts, home and kitchen, beauty, tech and toys. Every price is checked against recent price history before it goes on the site, and we never repeat inflated 'was' prices.

We're happy to hear about new launches, exclusive offers and seasonal campaigns, and to give you details of the guides where your products would fit. We don't do cashback, voucher-code listings, paid social or PPC brand bidding.

How we earn money is explained in our [affiliate disclosure](/disclosure/).
